content.short: Avalanche is a future-proof and developer-friendly layer 1 blockchain protocol.
content.description: Avalanche was launched in 2020 with the aim of delivering fast, versatile, secure, affordable, and accessible blockchain infrastructure. Its native token AVAX is used to pay transaction fees, secure the network, and serve as a basic unit of account across Avalanche blockchains. The network supports near-instant transaction completion and can process up to 4,500 transactions per second. Avalanche is open source, inviting anyone to view and contribute to its codebase.
